before: modifierBonus summed all sources then applied one ratio floor
after: R007-1: ratio modifiers floor each source (native Count* step) separately then sum; multiplier unchanged; ModifierSpec.pooled keeps combined floor (community Lianka/YeLuo only)
affects: 46 multi-source ratio prototypes (incl. gw_Runeforger); troop:6320 7470 accepted value changes (armor 50 case 25->24)

before: DecreaseRandom/StealRandom rolled attack/armor/magic (3-stat pool)
after: R007-2: 4-Skill pool attack/armor/hp/magic equal odds; Life reduced directly (no armor/barrier); StealRandom Life grows caster Life+max Life (IncreaseHealth)
affects: all reduce stat='random' segments (~30 prototypes incl. gw_EyeOfXathenos, gw_StaffOfMadness, gw_ScarabOfNefertani); rng draws nextInt(4) instead of nextInt(3)

before: random damage waves / enemyRandomN splash centres preferred not-yet-hit enemies (C3); native RandomAlly+RandomPrefNotPrevAlly assembled as allyRandomN (distinct) or allyRandom
after: R007-3: waves/splash centres avoid only the previous pick (randomPrefer 'notHit' kept for 8160 plain RandomEnemy x3); new TargetMode allyRandomPrefNotPrevN (each pick avoids only the previous, repeats allowed) for 15 ally chains; 7945 second Submerged allyRandomPrefNotPrev; 9641 damage randomWaves 2; enemyRandomPrefNotPrev (weapon:1142) unchanged, already R007-3
affects: 22 random-wave/splash prototypes, 16 RandomPrefNotPrevAlly spells; lone-ally casts now apply each native step (2-3 applications)

before: 8597: reduce capped Magic+1+2xGreen by front Attack, Life gain only healed (max Life unchanged); 9139/9223: steal [Magic+1] + ratio 100:1 targetStat (stole the whole stat), heal-only gain
after: reduce options modifierAfterCap (counter = min(stat, base) + modifier; gain = counter) and gainLifeMode 'gain' (native IncreaseHealth: Life+max Life). 8597 uses both; 9139/9223 steal min(stat, Magic+1) with Life+max gain
affects: only reduce segments with gainStat hp (3 prototypes); default steal behaviour unchanged

before: AiColorChooser/AiCellChooser ignored native spell Target (could pick the target colour, a Skull or a special gem)
after: gowChoiceRules.ts maps native Target (Not<X>OrSkullGems, Not<X>Gems, <X>Gems, ManaGemsOnly) for 75 spell ids onto compiled prototypes (WeakMap, prototype data unchanged); TurnEngine passes the rule; AI choosers skip disallowed colours / non-Mana or wrong-colour cells. Player palette in src/render/App.ts NOT restricted (UI follow-up)
affects: AI casts of 75 spells with chosen colour/gem; FixedColor/CellChooser (player, tests, golden) unchanged

before: every gem segment called resolveBoardChange at once: a create/transform/jumble settled gravity+cascades before the next native step (7280 Brown creation landed after the first cascade)
after: during castSkill, pure board rewrites (no gems removed) defer the settle to the end of the spell; destroy/explode still settle immediately (and absorb any pending rewrite)
affects: every spell with a create/convert/jumble step followed by other steps: cascade and its rng draws move after the remaining steps; 12 golden-signed keys changed (ordering / rng only)

before: L1B02Repro it.fails: charm expected to be instant (no lasting status)
after: R008: charm is a persistent auto-recovering negative status (R004 shared cumulative chance, reset on new negative, blocked by Blessed); repro asserts the lasting status; no runtime change
affects: 16 native Charm skills (R008 list)

before: prototypeChosenTargetMode scanned root segments only; enemyChosen/allyChosen used only inside oneOf never requested -> spell 7460 had no effect
after: scan recurses into oneOf branches (root order first, then branch order); 7460 now requests enemy target
affects: every oneOf prototype whose chosen target is branch-only (registry scan: 7460; the 7 sa-F1 rows already had inputTarget)

before: summon/summonCopy resolved side via findSide(caster); after the caster died in the same cast the summon was skipped; 7542 used self-kill + selfRevive(full)
after: summon/summonCopy fall back to ctx.casterSide captured at cast start; 7542 = native Damage@Self 1, Damage@Self 10000, SummoningNoError Sunbird 6387 (fresh troop, death hooks fire)
affects: summon/summonCopy segments after the caster died mid-cast

before: LAST_TARGET / CHOSEN_TARGET colour looked up the live roster; a target killed earlier in the cast resolved to nothing (9476 kill branch converted no gem)
after: castTracking.colorsAtCastStart snapshot; LAST_TARGET / CHOSEN_TARGET fall back to it when the unit left the roster (9476 K: 1 gem of the dead enemy's colour -> Daemonic Portal)
affects: all LAST_TARGET / CHOSEN_TARGET colour specs after a kill in the same cast

before: native RemoveColor / RemoveGems compiled as clear mode destroy: removed gems gave mana, removed Skulls dealt skull damage
after: new clear mode remove (no mana, no skull damage, no special-gem chain/resources; still counted in castTracking.destroyed, gravity + cascades as usual); applied at registration to the 85 spells whose only native gem-clearing steps are Remove* (gowRemoveRules.ts); weapon reviewed overrides 7124/7230/7577/8347/8807/9111 synced
affects: 85 spell ids in NATIVE_REMOVE_SPELL_IDS; special-gem trigger under Remove proposed in rulings/R010

before: native CountAttackArmorLife (one Count step) curated as 3-4 separate stat sources; since R007-1 each source floored separately (8228 L10 E11 482)
after: ModifierSpec.sourceGroups (one floor per group = native step); 8228 = [attack+armor+life] + [magic] (E11 481); the 9 other CountAttackArmorLife rows (7252 7454 7644 7975 8203 8238 8751 9184 9882) pooled: true (single floor)
affects: 10 CountAttackArmorLife prototypes; golden diff 0 new lines

before: no global 'FromTarget is damaged after the hit' condition; 7791 missed the native CountSet@FromTarget [AddForDamaged] -> Enrage@Self step
after: new global condition chosenTargetDamaged (chosen target alive and hp < maxHp); 7791 appends inflict rage@Self ifCond chosenTargetDamaged
affects: new condition kind only

before: targetStatBeatsCaster reads castTracking.lastTarget (unset before the first targeted segment) -> souls followed the damage and compared post-hit Life
after: new global condition chosenTargetStatBeatsCaster (chosen target's current stat vs caster); 7670 native order: souls 10 (+20 if chosen enemy Life > caster Life) then damage x3 on the same pre-hit comparison
affects: new condition kind only

before: explode first (skull/mana settle before the spell damage), damage boosted by destroyedGems Blue
after: new modifier source chosenCellBlockGems (native CountGems Block3x3 around the chosen cell, read before the explosion); 7553 native order: dispel, true damage, explode last
affects: new modifier source kind only

before: applyStatus: a Blessed unit rejected every status except blessed/curse (positives too: Barrier, Enchanted, Reflect, Enraged, Submerged)
after: Blessed blocks only negative statuses (R004 resetting-negative set + negative cleanse set, curse family excluded: curse still cancels blessed); positives apply normally
affects: every skill/trait/gem giving a positive status to a Blessed unit; bless-then-positive spells 9661 (troop:7700), 9594 (troop:7666), 8469 (troop:6966)

before: BelowTarget/AboveTarget/NextDown/ChosenAndBelow/ChosenAndNextDown/Adjacent anchored on the chosen unit's current formation index and returned [] once an earlier step of the same cast killed it
after: castTracking.formationAtCastStart (ids per team at cast start); when the anchor left the roster, above/below = units before/after its cast-start slot (NextDown = first surviving below); Adjacent = its cast-start neighbours that are still alive (no shifting further); anchor alive: unchanged. troop:6843 8248 single-segment ChosenAndNextDown kept (equivalent)
affects: every prototype using enemyBelowTarget/enemyAboveTarget/allyBelowTarget/enemyNextDown/enemyChosenAndNextDown/enemyChosenAndBelow/enemyChosenAndAdjacent (33 entities; 9 change in K)

before: no test for removed special gems
after: test: removed bomb/doomSkull/manaPotionGem do not trigger, destroyed ones do; runtime unchanged

before: army count sources (teamSize/alliesOf*/enemiesOf* Race/Kingdom/Color) read the live roster when the consuming segment runs: units killed by an earlier segment of the same spell were no longer counted
after: new atCastStart flag reads castTracking.unitsAtCastStart (alive units at cast start, native Count* at step 0); set on the 26 spells whose native step-0 Count precedes a segment that can kill the counted side
affects: situational: only when a counted unit dies earlier in the same cast; ally-only counts after enemy damage left unflagged (no observable change)

before: boardSpecial / destroyedGems special / special clear targets matched on kind only: Good and Bad Gargoyles merged; Dragon<Color> counts used every gem of the colour (9527 9494 9532) or every dragon gem (9371 9649)
after: boardSpecial {tier?, color?}, destroyedGems {specialTier?}, clear target special {tier?} / randomGems {specialTier?} (missing gem tier = 1); 9918 explodes Bad only, 9022 Good only, 8797 counts Bad only, 9547 counts Good and Bad as separate floored steps, dragon counters use dragonGem + colour
affects: only boards with gargoyle / dragon gems; golden review board has none (diff 0 new lines)

before: damage on enemyChosenAndNextDown without range resolved 2 victims but hit only the first
after: enemyChosenAndNextDown defaults to range all like enemyChosenAndBelow (curated range:'all' workarounds now redundant)
affects: no curated skill without explicit range (6904/8365 and r22 already pass range all)

before: 8417 counted listed statuses across all enemies; 8640 condBonus anyOf added +12 once; 9808 allyStatusCount blessed included the caster
after: new source targetStatusCount {statusIds} = listed statuses on the chosen target at cast start (8417 x10, 8640 x12); allyStatusCount excludeSelf (9808 AllAlliesButNotSelf)
affects: situational (statuses on target / Blessed caster)

before: casterStatBeatsTarget / targetStatBeatsCaster read castTracking.lastTarget only (false before the first targeting segment); 9291 had to grant Barrier after the hit (post-damage Armor)
after: both fall back to the chosen target when no lastTarget exists; 9291 native order Barrier (Armor compare) then damage
affects: also seg-0 damage condMult/condBonus using these conditions (7454 7458 7960 9651 7192 / Kingslayer) now evaluate against the chosen target pre-hit; golden diff 0 new lines

before: no single-unit NextUpFromTarget mode; 8485 silenced both neighbours with one shared 30% roll (enemyChosenAndAdjacent)
after: new target mode enemyNextUp (living enemy right above the chosen one, R012 cast-start slot); 8485 silence chosen / enemyNextUp / enemyNextDown, three independent 30% rolls
affects: troop:6982 only (random split)

before: prototypeNeedsColor ignored modifier sources; 8060 never asked for a colour and its boardGems CHOSEN count read 0 (created 0 Red)
after: boardGems 'CHOSEN' sources anywhere in a segment trigger the colour chooser; 8060 creates one Red per gem of the chosen colour
affects: registry scan: 8060 only

before: only lastTargetColor existed (needs a prior targeting segment), so 8467 dealt the true damage first and column skulls could miss a killed front target
after: global condition chosenTargetColor (cast-start colours of the chosen target); 8467 native order DestroyColumn -> IncreaseAttack -> TrueDamage
affects: troop:6964 only

before: 8928 counted Red / Brown / Skull gems on the whole board (L10 dmg 178)
after: castTracking.chosenRowAtCastStart + source chosenRowAtCastStart: only the chosen row, captured before the explode (26 + 8 x row count)
affects: troop:7316 only

before: storms had one colour; Hellstorm (native StormRedPurple) approximated as a Red storm
after: Team.storm.color2 / storm segment color2 / createStorm opts.color2: both colours get STORM_DROP_WEIGHT in refills, stormPresent matches either; 8560 8562 8454 Red + Purple
affects: storm-change event still reports the primary colour only (UI shows a Red storm)

before: condMult kingdomOf side enemy: any living enemy from the kingdom doubled the hit on any target; zh desc 造成l
after: new target-relative condition targetKingdom (segment target, fallback chosen target); kingdom weapons anyOf(targetKingdom, kingdomPresent), 9593 targetKingdom; zh stray l removed (pool-w01 + override description/prototype for 34 spells); generator hKingdomCond emits targetKingdom
affects: only kingdom weapons + 9593 used kingdomOf enemy

before: TurnEngine.castSkill removed the caster's Enchanted/Submerged/Blessed before the spell body; allyStatusCount/selfStatus/anyAllyStatus never saw the caster's own status
after: removed ids kept in ctx.actionEndedStatusIds (and castTracking.statusesAtCastStart of the caster); allyStatusCount / selfStatus / anyAllyStatus count the caster; the status is still removed
affects: self-including allyStatusCount/anyAllyStatus/selfStatus users of submerged/blessed/enchanted: troop:6412 6417 6519 6576 6713 6823 6968 7109 7262 7405 7650 7729 7813 weapon:1156

before: failed chance roll of an execute segment returned before target resolution (no lastTarget); 8664 wrote true damage before the slay roll
after: runSegment: failed roll of a damage execute segment still resolves/tracks its targets; 8664 native order execute enemyLast -> trueDmg lastTarget
affects: execute+chance segments followed by lastTarget/ifTargetDied steps now see the (surviving) victim: troop:6252 6460 6585 6753 7016 7145 7252 7797

before: summon id = max living id + 1: killing the highest-id unit made the next summon reuse its id, lastTarget resolved to the summon and later ifTargetDied summons skipped
after: monotonic allocateCharId (GameState.charIdHighWater records removed ids); dead ids never reused
affects: every summon (ids after a kill now > highest removed id)

before: troopPresent boolean: 3 extra Doomskulls / 3 more Magic if any Eldritch Minion / Despond ally
after: modifier source alliesNamed {name, atCastStart}: 3 per matching ally (native CountArmyTroop step 0 counter)

before: lastTargetColor/Race/Status false once the hit killed the target (unit spliced, findCharacter undefined)
after: castTracking.lastTarget.unit keeps the picked Character; colour/race/status conditions read it after death
affects: lastTargetColor/Race/Status users: 8925 8276 8533 8373 9550 7410 7541

before: transform diagonal fixed to the board's main diagonals; prototypeNeedsCell ignored oneOf branches (8448 / 7943 chosen row/col explode had no cell and exploded nothing)
after: transform diagonalAnchor 'chosenCell' (row-col / row+col of the chosen cell); prototypeNeedsCell recurses into oneOf options
affects: Target Board spells whose cell step is inside a random oneOf branch: 8762 8448 7943

before: 8965 counted and destroyed the fixed centre X; 8070 exploded first and marked per destroyed skull (killed enemies left the pool), attack before armor
after: diagonalGems anchor chosenCell + area x center CELL; chosenCellBlockGems skulls; 8070 native order count -> death marks -> explode -> armor -> attack

before: alliesOfKingdom zh parent kingdom (卜筮之原 / 齐埃金) counted every Adana / Zaejin ally
after: alliesNamed name[] = raw KingdomId 3048 / 3053 roster zh names (Wild Court 5, Amanithrax 5)

before: kingdom filters (targetKingdom / alliesOfKingdom / kingdomOf) matched the zh kingdom name, which faction troops share with their parent kingdom (e.g. raw 3070 troops = 圣唐)
after: troops.json/Character carry raw native kingdomId; KingdomRef number matches kingdomId; curated users of native AllyKingdom / CountArmyKingdom / MultiplyForKingdom<id> switched to the id; kingdomPresent (battle kingdom) keeps the zh name
affects: 126 skills with a native kingdom id step; only differs when a faction troop (or mis-assigned zh kingdom) is on the field
